title: Air Quality Index Levels — What Can You Do?
claims: Good (0–50): no action required; described as a good day for outdoor exercise.
Moderate (51–100): people who are unusually sensitive to air pollution should take steps to reduce prolonged or heavy exertion outdoors.

Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups (101–150): it is still OK to exercise outdoors, but sensitive groups should reduce prolonged or heavy exertion, for example by walking instead of running or exercising when air quality is better.
Unhealthy (151–200): sensitive groups should avoid prolonged or heavy exertion outdoors; everyone should reduce outdoor exertion.
Very Unhealthy (201–300): sensitive groups should avoid all outdoor exertion; everyone else should limit it.
Hazardous (301–500): health warnings of emergency conditions.

claimVerification.note: 表内 Good (0-50) 行原文：“No action required. A good day for outdoor exercise!”
表内 Moderate (51-100) 行原文：“Some people are unusually sensitive to air pollution. If you are one of them, take steps to reduce prolonged or heavy exertion outdoors”。

表内 101-150 行原文：“It’s still OK to exercise outdoors, but if you’re in a sensitive group, take steps to reduce prolonged or heavy exertion. Examples: Take a walk instead of a run … or exercise when air quality is better”，与 claim 的“仍可户外运动、减量、走代替跑”一致。
表内 Unhealthy (151-200) 行原文：“Sensitive groups should avoid prolonged or heavy exertion outdoors … Everyone should take steps to reduce outdoor exertion.”
表内 Very Unhealthy (201-300) 行原文：“Sensitive groups should avoid all outdoor exertion. Everyone else should limit it.”
表内 Hazardous (301-500) 行原文：“Health warnings of emergency conditions.”，页面未再展开具体行动建议。
